youtube.description:
Claude free vs Pro: 5 differences that matter, checked against the official pricing page in October 2026.

Claude free vs Pro: 5 things Pro adds. Checked on the pricing page.

1. Opus - Opus needs Pro or above. Free has Sonnet.
2. Research - Research reports need a paid plan.
3. Claude Code - Claude Code is not on the Free plan.
4. Design Tools - Design, Slides, Docs: beta, paid plans only.
5. Extras - Pro adds scheduled tasks and Claude in Chrome. Free still has artifacts and Projects.
